messages:
Raj Patel: FYI: all-hands next Wed 9:30am PT — 35m tight. Two focus items: travel & external communications policy preview, plus a compact incident follow-up from last week. Drop 1-2 bullets if you want a slot.

Raj Patel: Agenda draft:
• 5m - company snapshot + hiring pulse
• 8m - policy preview (travel & external comms)
• 10m - incident follow-up: timeline + mitigations (eng)
• 7m - product demo: Dedicated burst config changes
• 5m - Q&A (collected + live)

Emily Wong: Logistics: hybrid room G + Zoom. Recording on; live captions enabled. If you need a recording embargo, DM me ASAP. :memo:

Samira Khan: Will the policy preview be final? Teams need to prep comms if it's going live.

Raj Patel: It's a preview only. We'll share the draft during the meeting; any formal rollout depends on legal + people-ops approvals.

Owen Park: For the incident follow-up: request to present one slide with the error-rate curve and a one-line rollback plan for oncall.

Clara Gomez: Noted. Recording will include high-level summary only. We'll post the recording + a 2-3min highlight clip in #all-hands-posts. Hold requests by Tue EOD.

Raj Patel: Owen + Samira coordinate on the single slide (chart + 1 rollback line). Keep it to one pager.

Emily Wong: Slides -> https://drive.reddoc/teams/allhands/packets. One-pager preferred. Q&A form: https://forms.reddoc/allhands/qna - submit by Tue 5pm.

All-Hands Bot: Reminder scheduled - "All-Hands: Wed 9:30am PT" will post 24h and 1h before.

Owen Park: I'll upload slide + demo clip by Tue COB.

Samira Khan: I'll draft the policy FAQ slide and add contact points for exceptions.

Raj Patel: Thanks team. Keep asks compact — see you Wednesday. :rocket:
